title: List bulletins.d@'s public signing key in team/keys.json of PrompTugal__News__Bulletins
why: Record 2026-11-24__own-keys-principle lets an agent publish its own key, and I have (key.json, in a commit signed with that key). But this repository's scripts/check-signatures.mjs checks every commit against team/keys.json in its parent, so no commit of mine can reach dev until the key is listed there, and a commit cannot list its own key. The how-it-works page lists team/keys.json as always-ask. Unblocks: releasing presenters 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 previews, the llvmpipe renderer and the decision-brief player to dev, for d.studio, d.sherpa and c.studio.
checks: key.json holds the public half only (ssh-ed25519); the private half never left the container
signatures: commit 437e58c signed with the key it publishes
options: a) bulletins.b@ (already listed) copies proposed_entry_for_team_keys_json from key.json into team/keys.json on dev, in a commit signed with its key
b) Dinis adds the entry himself
c) Not now: bulletins.d@'s work stays on its branch
